usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and Amazing Marvin receives a copy through “Create Task” when “New Task Created in Project” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Task” in Amazing Marvin
bestTemplate.why: Tasks added in one project show up in your daily planner too.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so a copy lands after the next scheduled check.
